acceptedFindings.basis: Daijisen defines 妥 at character level as calmly settling and a matter becoming settled (01-extract.txt:7), consistent with its displayed settled title. 了, 定 and 済 display settling/settle; their cited bodies support this sense. 決's complete cited meaning paragraph explicitly describes deciding or settling and becoming settled. acceptedFindings.fix: Append 了, 定, 済 and 決 to 妥's exclusions, preserving the original nine and the sourced settled sense. Briefly distinguish the relevant settlement senses without claiming word interchangeability.

acceptedFindings.basis: Daijisen 循 sense 1 is following a set rule (02-extract.txt:7). 則 explicitly displays follow a model and teaches following a rule, precedent or model. 倣 teaches following an existing model or precedent; 準 teaches conformity to a model and glosses 準じる/準ずる as conform to. The title follow is therefore defensible for these comparison prompts. The audit verifies that none of the three direct pairs is declared.
acceptedFindings.fix: Append 則, 倣 and 準 to 循's exclusions, preserving the original six; explain the particular rule/model-following overlap. Do not infer these pairs merely from existing 守 or 追 exclusions.
acceptedFindings.scope: The safeguard does not identify following a rule with every act of imitation or every meaning of 準.
